title: Delay-induced multistability in one-dimensional swarmalators with common intrinsic frequency
summary: We study the delayed one-dimensional swarmalator model when all units share a common intrinsic frequency ω. Unlike the zero-frequency case, ω cannot be removed by a rotating-frame transformation because delayed interactions retain the phase accumulated over the lag. The result is a two-order-parameter analogue of the delayed Kuramoto model: the asynchronous state acquires incoherence lobes, the synchronized state becomes a rotating branch stable even when both the spatial and phase couplings are repulsive, and the phase wave develops narrow resonant stability bands.
